stem: A figure in the plane undergoes rotation by $90^\circ$ clockwise, followed by reflection across the $x$-axis. Which single matrix represents the composite transformation (acting on column vectors)?
workedSolution: Applying $T_1$ then $T_2$ to a column vector $\mathbf{v}$ gives $T_2(T_1\mathbf{v}) = (M_{2}M_{1})\mathbf{v}$ — the matrix applied FIRST sits on the RIGHT. Multiplying in the wrong order gives $\begin{pmatrix} 0 & -1 \\ -1 & 0 \end{pmatrix}$, a different transformation — matrix multiplication is not commutative.
